{{Top|leg}}
'''Leisa''' was one of the two urban centers located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vycinyth]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], alongside [[Pleia]]. Leisa's architecture was unique and sculpted.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
